scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @meyou/api" "npm run dev -w @meyou/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @meyou/shared && npm run build -w @meyou/api && npm run build -w @meyou/worker && npm run build -w @meyou/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @meyou/shared && npm run test -w @meyou/shared && npm run test -w @meyou/api && npm run test -w @meyou/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @meyou/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
